UserTask.title: UserTask
UserTask.description: A synced handwriting or typed to-do task belonging to an authenticated user.

text.description: Recognized or typed task description text (1 to 2000 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task has been completed.

clientCreatedAt.description: Original device creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserNote.title: UserNote
UserNote.description: A saved note created from recognized handwriting or edited directly by the user.

title.description: Optional note title up to 200 characters.

content.description: Main body text of the note (1 to 20000 characters).

clientCreatedAt.description: Original device creation timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server last-updated timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().
